ledger.claim: The driver was told, and read, that the rider was coming, and cancelled anyway. Rider message MSG-03109-002 ('coming down now') was sent at 18:43:45 inside the waiting window and its read receipt shows the driver opened it at 18:44:15, yet the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds of it and placed no in-app voice call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty) before terminating the trip at 18:47:45 — 240 seconds of unbroken silence after being told the rider was on the way down. Limbs (a) and (b) of POL-NS-04 are satisfied on this record: the message is coordinating content of the kind limb (a) contemplates, and limb (b)'s 120 second reply window and call requirement are both failed by the driver.

I do not press limb (c) of POL-NS-04, and I do not repeat the rider's assertion of having stood at the pin for six minutes. The rider's own device track places it 715.46 m to 722.44 m from the pickup pin across the whole window, reports a single speed value of 0.0 km/h, and yields rider_qualifying_fix_count 0 against the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius. Rider presence at the pin cannot be shown on this evidence, so POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider on limb (c) and I put that limb forward no further.

POL-NS-06 gives the rider nothing on these numbers and I will not assert a shortfall that the trace does not show. The derived arrival reports a single continuous in-geofence run of 380 seconds, from 18:41:25 to 18:47:45, against the free waiting period in force of 180 seconds (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec), with run_count 1 and no excursions — a margin of 200 seconds. The absent advisory EV-ADVIS-03109-01 is MISSING (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0) so the limb (i) accumulation route under POL-NS-06 is unavailable to the driver, but a single compliant run of 380 seconds does not need it.

The arrival relied on here is a driver's own button press, not a platform measurement. trip_record.platform_policy.arrival_marker is BUTTON, so POL-NS-12's platform-confirmed arrival route is not open and both the arrival finding and the start of the waiting clock have to be carried by the exported trace under POL-NS-02 — at least three consecutive fixes at 25 m horizontal accuracy or better inside the 120 m LARGE_VENUE arrival radius, with the dwell measured from the first qualifying in-geofence fix and not from the tap. The rider puts the driver to proof of that test on the derived block rather than on the marker.

No adverse inference about this rider may be drawn from the profile. The only rider fields that can ground a finding in this category are no_show_disputes_30d, which POL-NS-09(d) reads, and disputes_with_counterparty_90d, which POL-NS-09(c) reads; both are 0 on EV-RPROF-03109, so neither the abuse limb nor the same-rider-and-driver limb is engaged. The other numbers on that profile, including its lifetime no-show flag counter, are context only under POL-GEN-01 and may not be substituted for the trailing-window figures to build a finding against the rider.

The present payment state must be read before any party-relative label is attached. EV-FARE-03109 shows payment_status CHARGED with total_charged 4.50 and refund_issued_sgd 0.00, so NO_ACTION under POL-GEN-03 does not sit neutrally between the parties: it leaves the contested $4.50 with the platform and returns nothing to the rider. On a rider-filed dispute over a fee already collected, a no-action disposition is a loss for the rider, not a neutral outcome.

The cancellation fee is chargeable under POL-NS-01 because all four limbs hold on this record. Limb (a): EV-TRIP-03109 carries a driver 'arrived' event at 2026-08-17T18:41:25+08:00. Limb (b): the trace in EV-GPS-03109 places the driver inside the pickup geofence at or before that event, the first qualifying in-geofence fix being timestamped at exactly 18:41:25. Limb (c): the driver then held position continuously for 380 seconds, measured from that first qualifying fix, well past the free waiting period in force. Limb (d): the trip record shows no boarding event and records the trip terminated by the driver at 18:47:45 with cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, after the required dwell had elapsed.

Arrival is established on the POL-NS-02 test, not merely asserted. The trace contains 39 qualifying position fixes inside the pickup geofence, each passing the 25 m horizontal-accuracy filter, and the qualifying run is continuous over 39 consecutive fixes from 18:41:25 to 18:47:45. The trip record fixes the zone class as LARGE_VENUE, for which POL-NS-02 sets an arrival radius of 120 m, and carries one registered pickup point at the Northpoint City venue.

The dwell limb of POL-NS-01 is satisfied with margin. The driver's in-geofence dwell was 380 continuous seconds, from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 18:41:25 to cancellation at 18:47:45, which is 200 seconds more than the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec); the derived shortfall against the minimum is negative 200 seconds, meaning a surplus, not a deficit. platform_policy.no_show_threshold_sec is not set for this trip, so no longer threshold applies. The 380-second dwell also exceeds the 300-second LARGE_VENUE figure retained in fee_schedule.minimum_dwell_sec, so the outcome does not turn on which of the two figures governs.

POL-NS-05 does not bite. The 'arrived' event was a driver-pressed marker, and at the moment it was pressed the driver was already inside the arrival geofence: the arrival timestamp 18:41:25 coincides with the first fix of the qualifying in-geofence run (dwell_start_offset_sec 0.0), and the driver's closest recorded position to the pin over the whole trip is 0.11 m. He was therefore neither more than 300 m from the pickup pin nor travelling at 15 km/h or above when he tapped 'I'm Here', and the waiting clock runs from 18:41:25 exactly as the record states. The driver's high-speed fixes (57 to 62 km/h) fall in the en-route portion of the trace, before the geofence run begins.

POL-NS-06 cannot assist the rider. The effective in-geofence dwell is a single continuous 380-second run with a run_count of 1, and the derived shortfall against the required minimum is negative 200 seconds. There is no waiting-period shortfall and no premature cancellation, so limb (ii) of POL-NS-06 (shortfall refund) has no application on this record.

The rider's contact clause does not exonerate the rider, because POL-NS-04 limb (c) is affirmatively failed on admissible fixes. Even taking limbs (a) and (b) at their highest - the rider sent 'coming down now' at 18:43:45 and the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds and made no in-app call (trip_record.in_app_calls is empty) - limb (c) requires the rider's track to place the rider within the 150 m LARGE_VENUE rider-presence radius for the majority of qualifying fixes. It does not: across all 67 rider fixes the rider's distance from the pickup pin runs from 715.46 m to 722.44 m, and rider_qualifying_fix_count inside the presence radius is 0. Because limb (c) is affirmatively failed rather than undecidable, POL-NS-04 does not apply and the dispute is decided under POL-NS-01.

The rider's central factual assertion - that he 'stood at the pin for six full minutes' - is contradicted by the rider's own device. The rider track's minimum distance from the pickup pin is 715.46 m and its mean is 719.15 m across the whole window; the rider was stationary the entire time (the only speed value in the track is 0.0 kph) roughly seven-tenths of a kilometre away. The clause the rider invokes, 'POL-NS-14', is not a clause of the policy in force; the only rider-exonerating routes in this category are POL-NS-04, POL-NS-05, POL-NS-06 and POL-NS-10, and on this record each of them is unavailable.

POL-NS-11 does not rescue the rider either. That clause applies only where the rider's track is absent or wholly filtered out for accuracy so that limb (c) of POL-NS-04 cannot be run. Here the rider track is present, populated and complete, with 67 fixes over the window, so limb (c) is runnable and was run: it failed on the numbers rather than being undecidable, and no inference about the rider's location is required or permitted.

POL-NS-03 is not engaged. That clause governs a driver stationary outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius but within 400 m of the pin - a wrong-entrance or wrong-block case. The driver's stationary fixes here are inside the arrival radius, at a minimum recorded distance of 0.11 m from the pin, so this is not a wrong-face-of-the-venue case and no fault allocation from the chat log arises. There is accordingly no route to the pin-ambiguity goodwill payment in POL-NS-03(ii).

Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the cancellation fee in force for this trip. The fee in force is SGD 4.50 (trip_record.platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd), so the driver's compensation is SGD 3.60 - the figure the fare breakdown's own money block reports as driver_compensation under POL-NS-07.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip, so the compensation is payable and the case does not escalate under POL-NS-09(d). driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4 that the clause requires, and the clause needs both limbs in any event. The lifetime counter driver_profile.prior_no_show_flags (2) is a different field, is not the field POL-NS-07 reads, and may not be substituted for the trailing-30-day figure.

ledger.claim: There is no integrity defect under POL-NS-08(d) in the amount the fee is computed on. The fare breakdown's cancellation_fee line of SGD 4.50 equals the cancellation fee in force carried on the trip record (platform_policy.cancellation_fee_sgd of SGD 4.50), so the line reconciles with resolution_rule and the base for the driver's 80 percent is not in question. The fare ledger also shows payment_status CHARGED with refund_issued_sgd 0.00 against total_charged 4.50.

No escalation trigger under POL-NS-09 is present, so this case is decididable on the record. Every artifact bearing on arrival, dwell and rider presence is COMPLETE at weight_multiplier 1.0 - the trip record, the GPS trace and the chat log all carry no issues - so POL-NS-09(e) is not engaged. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c) is not met. rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 0, so limb (d) is not met. And no admissible artifact contradicts another on arrival or dwell: the trip record's 6.3-minute wait and the trace's 380-second in-geofence run agree.

The one absent artifact does not help either side and does not impair this case. EV-ADVIS-03109-01 is MISSING: it carries no payload, weight_multiplier 0.0 and the blocking issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, with the note that no advisory covers Northpoint City in this window. The driver does not rely on POL-NS-06(i) accumulation, which the derivation confirms is unavailable - the trace shows a single in-geofence interval, so there is no second interval to sum and no traffic advisory is needed. The absence is immaterial to the result, which rests on the continuous 380-second run.

The outcome this case produces is DRIVER_COMPENSATION. POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full, POL-NS-07 fixes the payout at SGD 3.60 after the anti-farming check passes, and under POL-GEN-03 that ruling is emitted as DRIVER_COMPENSATION with amount_sgd mirroring driver_compensation_sgd. The rider's SGD 4.50 charge stands as it presently is; the rider's claim is not supported by the evidence, and the money the case moves is the driver's SGD 3.60.
